rules.name: xoga713-var-mult-view-check
rules.sql: SELECT count(*) AS view_rows, count(curr_mult) AS with_curr_mult, count(lot_mult) AS with_lot_mult, count(mult_factor) AS with_mult_factor FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :cob

SELECT v.invenio_product_code, p.curr_mult_factor, p.curr_mult_type, p.constant_curr_mult FROM opera.var_product_code_mapping_table v LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table p ON p.tenant_id = v.tenant_id AND p.invenio_product_code = v.invenio_product_code WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view m WHERE m.tenant_id = v.tenant_id AND m.invenio_product_code = v.invenio_product_code AND m.value_date = :cob) ORDER BY v.invenio_product_code

SELECT m.invenio_product_code, p.curr_mult_type, p.constant_curr_mult, s.settle_value AS fx, m.curr_mult AS view_curr_mult, CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(p.curr_mult_type, '')) IN ('division', 'divide', 'div', '/') THEN 1 / NULLIF(s.settle_value, 0) ELSE s.settle_value END AS old_fallback FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view m JOIN opera.product_master_table p ON p.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND p.invenio_product_code = m.invenio_product_code JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table s ON s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.underlying_id = p.curr_mult_factor AND s.value_date = m.value_date WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant AND m.value_date = :cob AND abs(m.curr_mult - CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(p.curr_mult_type, '')) IN ('division', 'divide', 'div', '/') THEN 1 / NULLIF(s.settle_value, 0) ELSE s.settle_value END) > 0.000000001 ORDER BY m.invenio_product_code

expect.reason: the view returns about 124 products (legacy) for a date that has FX prices
curr_mult is filled where the FX price exists
only products without an FX price that day may be missing (2 seen on UAT, 5 Nov)
the client statement fallback (fx_factor) equals the view, so the statement does not change
